# advanced-memory-mcp
> **Research-Driven Knowledge Platform** - A dual-purpose system serving as both a powerful Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and a standalone React-based web application. Transform AI assistants into...

This project includes automated llms.txt generation for AI accessibility.
